about: sgd_finetune: items 5 and 7 of reports/2026-10-21_review_sgd-finding-influence.md. Plan reports/2026-10-21_plan_sgd-finetune.md. Filed before any run.

gates.G0_w0: runs first: faith_score.w0_check (seed-0 PGD within 10% of 0.69, CI-masked within 2% of 0.348, PGD floor <= 0.25; 0.209 on the L40). Fails: stop, nothing scored
gates.G1_adam_reproduces: Adam fine-tune's held-out P(o) and KL elsewhere at step 10 within 0.01 of 0.9993 and 0.0554 (E16). Fails: stop before the Pile states
gates.G2_sgd_state: the saved SGD fine-tune's do-nothing target P(o) at the trigger within 0.01 of stage rate's held-out P(o) (float16 storage). Fails: SGD rows reported, not scored
gates.R0_rate: stage split runs only if stage rate finds a passing SGD rate; if none, the null is reported with the grid's range (0.001 to 0.1 at step 10) and the experiment stops

setup.adam_finetune: Adam 3e-05 (E14, E16), regenerated in the split job
setup.harness: harness.measure: Pile rows 0..255, PGD 20 steps, ratios to W0 under adversary seed 0 in the same job; floor f = max/min - 1 of W0's PGD KL over seeds (0, 1); faith_score.verdict: pass <= 1.5/(1+f), fail >= 1.5(1+f), inconclusive between (about 1.24 to 1.81 on the L40's f 0.21). Stochastic uses its own floor (about 0.002)
setup.sgd_component_training: plain SGD on the alive (U, V), Gamma and Delta frozen, 10 steps, rate from (0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.3) whose largest ||delta-W|| / ||W0|| over matrices at step 10 is nearest the selected SGD fine-tune's (|log ratio|)
setup.sgd_finetune: plain SGD (no momentum) at (0.001, 0.003, 0.01, 0.03, 0.1); E4's rule: held-out P(o) >= 0.9 and KL elsewhere <= 0.11 at step 10, the lowest KL elsewhere among those
setup.task: emoticon arm A (CE on o at the trigger + KL elsewhere), batch 32, clip 1, seed 0, 10 steps, 24 matrices
